rationale.consistency: Mirrors CookieFilter exactly: reuses cookieFilterAction and filterAction constants, same module ID scheme, Validate, receiver naming, OUTER label idiom, and interface guards added in the right places.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles missing '=', empty string, quoted values, suffix preservation, exact name match, first-action-wins. Hand-rolled parser accepts anything with '=' (empty or invalid names), so 'unparseable' is a loose notion; whitespace around name/value is not trimmed.
rationale.scope: Only adds the new filter, its registration and guards; no unrelated edits or refactors.
rationale.readability: Clear helper with documented multi-return; Filter loop is easy to follow. Five return values from parseSetCookieValue is a bit heavy but documented.
rationale.robustness: No panics on any input (all slicing is bounds-safe); non-array fields pass through untouched; no shared mutable state.
rationale.maintainability: Reuses action types well, but UnmarshalCaddyfile is a verbatim copy of CookieFilter's (~40 lines) rather than a shared helper; parser is isolated and easy to swap.
